memories.title: Search in C:\Users\Adminis
memories.content: ## 调查结论 **`Blocked by permissions configuration` 不是 MCP 服务器连不上，而是 Cursor 的 `InteractivePermissionsService.shouldBlockMcp` 在权限层直接拦截了工具调用。** 你这次 `tdai_recall` 被拦的**直接证据**在日志里： **文件：** `C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Roaming\Cursor\logs\20260918T090323\window1\workbench.mcp.allowlist.log` ```text 2026-09-18 10:48:05.690 [info] [permissions-service] shouldBlockMcp: toolName="tdai_recall", providerIdentifier="tencentdb-memory" 2026-09-18 10:48:06.410 [info] [permissions-service] shouldBlockMcp: BLOCKED (readonly mode) toolName="tdai_recall", providerIdentifier="tencentdb-memory" ``` 同一文件更早时段（Agent
